verdict.rationale: The evidence shows dots connecting to first-party ChatGPT apps such as Gmail, Google Drive, GitHub and Slack, and using local developer tools and skills. Nothing documents adding or plugging in arbitrary MCP servers so dots can use their tools. App connectors are an adjacent feature, not MCP-client support, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
